description: Checks that the components a design board names actually appear at that board's route in the running build. Walks React's fiber tree in Playwright, collects each rendered component's name, and compares it with the board's `components` in design-map.json. React and react-native-web only; on any other stack, and for a parts board, it runs no walk and reports "not verifiable here".
